Netherland Travel: meat Croquettes
By: Giangi Townsend
Published: Sunday, May 20, 2012 - 11:28am

Ingredients




6 ½ ounces cooked meat shredded
1 ¼ oz. butter
1 ounce flour
¼ cup bouillon
Pinch nutmeg
Salt and pepper to taste
Soy sauce – optional to taste
1 egg
Breadcrumbs
Oil for frying (peanut)

Preparation

1 Melt butter over low heat, add flour, stir and cook until mixture forms into a ball.  Do not brown. Add the bouillon and stir until thickened.  Add salt, pepper and nutmeg, (Soy sauce) to taste. 2 Add the butter flour past to  the shredded meat and cool, preferably overnight.  Mixture should be stiff. Put mixture into pastry bag with large opening tip.  Pipe mixture into a 4” by 2” pieces. 3 Roll pieces thru breadcrumbs then thru lightly beaten egg, and again thru the bread crumbs.  Place in the refrigerator for about 1 hour. 4 Heat oil in the deep fryer, 3 to 4 inches of oil, heat to 350°. 5 Fry until golden brown, drain on paper towel.

About

I can spend the whole summer travelling and eating in Holland and never getting tired of the wonderful food prepared. 
The below recipe is a favorite that  I am sharing  in honor of Jeanette and Johan W. that have introduced me to Indonesian and Dutch cooking years ago, and was, and still is a family favorite.
